title: FieldBrief
tagline: Handover briefs with traceable evidence and visible unknowns.
inspiration: Operational handovers often flatten conflicting notes into a confident summary. FieldBrief keeps the evidence identifiers and unresolved observations in view so a reviewer can inspect the basis of the handover.
whatItDoes: Accepts labeled evidence, requests a structured brief from an available NVIDIA model through Nebius Token Factory, rejects references to unknown evidence IDs, and saves an owned record that can be exported or deleted.
howItWasBuilt: Next.js and TypeScript provide the interface and API. Server-side input and output validation surround the Nebius request. PostgreSQL stores workspace-owned results with expiry, while signed cookies and same-origin checks protect mutations.
technicalEvidence: Local automated verification is included in this repository. Real provider calls, cloud deployment and browser end-to-end verification remain pending.
authorship: Prepared with ChatGPT/Codex assistance. Shared Next.js/workspace infrastructure originates in code-up-matrix/axios-fx-compliance-agent; the product module was developed on 27 October 2026. Shared code must be disclosed under the event’s reuse rules.
eligibility: Public MIT source, working demo and judging access; sponsor technology must run in the product. Verify personal/geographic eligibility.
judgeAccessInstructions: Provide the private judging access code through the submission portal after live verification. Do not put it in public source.
challenges: A valid citation identifier does not prove the model interpreted its source correctly. The implementation rejects unsupported identifiers and preserves unknowns; semantic review remains a human responsibility.
accomplishments: The local suite verifies provider request shape, NVIDIA model availability checks, duplicate evidence rejection, citation validation, record ownership and cleanup. Live sponsor execution is still pending.
lessons: Evidence traceability and truth are separate properties. Both must be represented honestly in the interface and the demonstration.
next: Connect the event credentials, run a real NVIDIA inference on Nebius, verify the deployed flow and record the result with its provider/model identifier.
judgeFit: Demonstrates a concrete operational use of Nebius and an NVIDIA model, with a reviewable evidence workflow. Actual provider execution and judging access must be shown before submitting.
demo: Label the input notes as synthetic and show one contradiction.
